title: Locked household energy replication

source.title: Individual Household Electric Power Consumption
source.aggregation: Sum the 60 finite nonnegative minute-averaged kW readings within an hour, divide by 60. Incomplete hours have no observed target.

drift.method: last value plus full-history average change

seasonal_naive.method: repeat the last complete seasonal cycle

boosted.target: future value minus value at issue time

config.selection: Minimum validation MAE separately per horizon, ties broken by model name; no model or parameter changes after results are observed.
config.rolling_policy: Refit at each origin using only history then available, including earlier observations in the test period. This is prequential evaluation, not a single frozen-origin forecast.

limitations: A different household and whole-household consumption target, not a future holdout of appliance energy.
Protocol locked locally before downloading and inspecting target measurements; no external preregistration or pretraining exclusion claim.
Only complete sixty-minute target hours are scored; exclusions may make coverage unrepresentative during data outages.
Forward-filled historical inputs and training labels are flagged and can bias fits during long outages; evaluation labels are never filled.
Expanding histories may include past test observations available before later forecast origins.
Sparse origins, one household and four months do not establish production or cross-season generalization.
Serial dependence means nominal 80% intervals have no guaranteed coverage.
